_comment: Apply this policy to TWO principals (one-time setup):
_principals: IAM Role: jeffi-stores-ec2-role (used by EC2 instance — fetches secrets at container startup)
IAM User: the CI/CD IAM user whose AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY are stored in GitHub Secrets (fetches NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars before docker build)
_how_to_apply_role: aws iam put-role-policy --role-name jeffi-stores-ec2-role --policy-name JeffiSecretsManagerRead --policy-document file://deploy/aws/ec2-iam-policy.json
